newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Romanian foreign minister to visit Hungary.
newsitem.headline: Romanian foreign minister to visit Hungary.

text.p: New Romanian Foreign Minister Adrian Severin will visit Hungary this month in a sign of warming relations between two countries embroiled in long-running tensions over ethnic Hungarians in Romania.

"Mr Severin has accepted our invitation and will probably come on December 27, although we have yet to receive official confirmation," a Hungarian foreign ministry source told Reuters on Friday. "We expect the confirmation later today."

Hungary on Tuesday ratified a friendship treaty that guarantees borders and enshrines political and cultural rights for Romania's 1.6 million-strong ethnic Hungarian minority, an issue which had previously caused tension between the two nations.
Romanian President Emil Constantinescu's decision to include ethnic Hungarians in his government after his election victory last month has soothed troubled ties between the two countries.
The new Romanian government, led by Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea, was sworn in on Thursday.
